# ATT&CK coverage matrix

<!-- Generated by scripts/build.py from playbook frontmatter. Do not edit by hand. -->

Enterprise ATT&CK **v19.2** (collection modified 2026-08-05).

Coverage means a playbook exists with a hypothesis, telemetry requirements, at least one query surface, and unit tests. It does not mean the technique is fully detected: every playbook documents its own blind spots.

## Deliberate gaps

The library does not claim coverage of Reconnaissance, Resource Development, Initial Access or Exfiltration as tactics. Those either occur outside the estate's telemetry (Reconnaissance, Resource Development), are better served by control-specific tooling (Initial Access: mail security, vulnerability management), or are addressed indirectly through the collection and staging that precedes them (TH-019) and the channels used to carry them (TH-008, TH-016). Stating this explicitly is more useful than a matrix that implies uniform coverage.
